name: raspberryPiLocal
description: Access and admin procedures for the household Raspberry Pi over LAN and Tailscale. Actions: setupSshAccess (one-time SSH+key install), setupTailscale (join the tailnet for off-LAN access), setupRemoteDesktop (RealVNC over Tailscale), installClaudeCode (Node 18 + pure-JS Claude Code 1.0.x, the only path on 32-bit armhf), connect (`ssh pi`), connectRemoteDesktop (launch VNC viewer), formularyKeys (canonical credential key names).
author: GuildOS
